subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age and max-turn automatic rotation, and what config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines new public lifecycle config and decides how state survives automatic session resets, which automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add Opt-In Lifecycle Policy
options.body: Extend session reset policy with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Session Boundaries
options.body: Keep this as a requirement of the broader session-boundary/context-retention design so age, turn, and token-pressure rotation share one contract.

options.title: Defer Automatic Rotation
options.body: Document cron, compaction, context-pruning, and manual reset mitigations while avoiding new core lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Lifecycle Policy
recommendation.body: Extend session reset policy with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the daily reset policy and are the strongest routing owner for this cross-boundary session lifecycle decision.
